memories.author: D06
memories.text: function: independent in ADLs, walks 30 min daily, uses no aid. cognition: Mini‑Cog 4/5 (normal). falls: 0 in last 12 months, gait normal, timed up‑and‑go 9 sec (not raised risk). medicines: 5 regular (levocetirizine 5 mg OD, pregabalin 75 mg BD, diclofenac 50 mg BD after food, methylcobalamin 1500 mcg OD, sertraline 50 mg OD) – polypharmacy, review against Beers criteria advised. mood: reports low mood, PHQ‑9 estimated 8 (mild). carers: daughter Priya, lives nearby. goals: "I want to stay active and continue working part‑time."

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
levocetirizine 5 mg OD – continue
pregabalin 75 mg BD – continue
diclofenac 50 mg BD after food – continue
methylcobalamin 1500 mcg OD – continue
sertraline 50 mg OD – continue

memories.author: lab
memories.text:
CBC: Hb 13.2 g/dL (12‑16), WBC 6.8×10⁹/L (4‑10), platelets 210×10⁹/L (150‑400), eosinophils 6 % (1‑4).
Thyroid function: TSH 2.1 mIU/L (0.4‑4.5), Free T4 1.2 ng/dL (0.8‑1.8).

memories.author: patient
memories.text: Over the past three weeks I have had more frequent hives, especially in the evenings, with intense itching that wakes me. I think stress from work may be worsening it.

memories.author: D06
memories.text: function: still independent, walks 35 min, no new pain. cognition: Mini‑Cog not repeated (annual screen due next year). falls: 0 in last 12 months, gait normal, TUG 9 sec. medicines: 6 regular (added cetirizine 10 mg HS) – polypharmacy, Beers review pending. mood: reports improved mood, PHQ‑9 ~5. carers: daughter Priya. goals: "I would like to reduce the itching and keep walking without pain."

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
levocetirizine 5 mg OD – continue
cetirizine 10 mg HS – add
pregabalin 100 mg BD – increase from 75 mg
diclofenac 50 mg BD after food – continue
methylcobalamin 1500 mcg OD – continue
sertraline 50 mg OD – continue

memories.author: lab
memories.text:
PHQ‑9 score 5 (0‑4 mild, 5‑9 mild).
TSH 2.3 mIU/L (0.4‑4.5).
Vitamin B12 190 pg/mL (200‑900) – low borderline.

memories.author: D06
memories.text: MRI lumbar spine: mild posterior disc bulge at L4‑L5 causing slight nerve root compression; no significant stenosis. Correlation with left‑sided sciatica.

memories.author: D06
memories.text: Refer to physiotherapy for core strengthening and lumbar stabilization exercises to address sciatica and improve functional mobility.

memories.author: D06
memories.text: Physiotherapy report: patient attended 8 sessions, reports 40 % reduction in leg pain, improved straight‑leg raise. Advised to continue home exercise program and follow‑up in 3 months.

memories.author: front_desk
memories.text: Appointment booked for 2026-04-15 at 10:00 with Dr Kulkarni (Geriatrics).

memories.author: D06
memories.text: function: walks 40 min daily, reports less leg pain after physio. cognition: Mini‑Cog 4/5 (still normal). falls: 0 in last 12 months, gait normal, TUG 8 sec. medicines: 6 regular (levocetirizine, cetirizine, pregabalin 100 mg BD, diclofenac, methylcobalamin, sertraline) – polypharmacy, Beers review due. mood: PHQ‑9 4, reports good sleep. carers: daughter Priya. goals: "I want to stay pain‑free and continue my part‑time consulting work."

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
levocetirizine 5 mg OD – continue
cetirizine 10 mg HS – continue
pregabalin 100 mg BD – continue
diclofenac 50 mg BD after food – continue
methylcobalamin 1500 mcg OD – continue
sertraline 50 mg OD – continue
vitamin D3 1000 IU OD – add (for low B12 borderline)

memories.author: lab
memories.text:
CBC: Hb 13.0 g/dL, WBC 6.5×10⁹/L, eosinophils 4 % (within normal).
Thyroid function: TSH 2.0 mIU/L, Free T4 1.1 ng/dL.
Vitamin B12 225 pg/mL (now normal after supplementation).
